external_source.paper: Rosenfeld et al., Event-Ready Bell Test Using Entangled Atoms Simultaneously Closing Detection and Locality Loopholes, PRL 119 010402 (2017)
external_source.physical_platform: Two remotely entangled neutral atoms, LMU Munich; original 2016 historical experiments

all_original_attempts_audit.warning: Original source lab_1 and lab_2 contain all measurement attempts. Author pairs contain ONLY valid events, matched by preexisting +-100 ms computer-clock window with instrument exclusions. No unpaired original attempts were silently relabeled as missing outcomes or included in paired model scoring.

fixed_analysis.training: April previously selected valid event-ready pairs
fixed_analysis.validation: June entire previously selected valid event-ready pairs
fixed_analysis.model_M0: Local Bernoulli by own measurement setting only
fixed_analysis.model_Mjanus: Local Bernoulli by own and remote measurement setting
fixed_analysis.fitting: Equal Jeffreys Beta(0.5,0.5) smoothing in each model
fixed_analysis.model_Mpost: Explicitly secondary positive-other-outcome conditioning artifact, not used in the primary prediction
fixed_analysis.exploratory_marginal_tests: Four own-setting local-by-remote binomial z contrasts with Holm correction alpha=0.001

strict_scientific_gate.reason: Author valid matched pairs are a selected subset of original attempts; incomplete cross-wing joint all-attempt table and timing uncertainty preclude unconditional primary no-signalling causal inference.
